verdict.rationale: One community user reports a Claude Design flow into PenPot "via its MCP" that built PenPot components and design tokens, which suggests Claude Design can act as an MCP client. The product page also shows prompts that pull data from Salesforce, QuickBooks, Canva and HubSpot, implying integrations. However, no first-party doc says Claude Design supports adding arbitrary MCP servers, and the PenPot report is unclear about which side hosted the MCP. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of MCP server/connector configuration in Claude Design, clarity on whether custom or remote MCP servers can be added, details on tool-use permissions, and independent hands-on corroboration.
